title: THE LAST SIGNAL
subtitle: a wordless short
style: shot on 35mm film, subtle grain, cool desaturated palette with warm practical lights, naturalistic cinematography, no people

shots.prompt: Extreme wide establishing shot of a derelict concrete coastal radio station on a windswept headland at first light, thick sea mist rolling across dead grass, a rusted lattice antenna mast rising above the building, flat grey ocean beyond, cold blue dawn light, 24mm lens, deep focus
shots.motion: Very slow push in toward the station. Mist drifts across the foreground in thick banks, grass ripples in the wind, the sky brightens almost imperceptibly. Locked-off tripod with a faint drift.

shots.prompt: Interior of an abandoned radio control room, a single hard shaft of dawn light falling through a grimy window onto banks of dead analogue equipment, dust thick in the air, peeling paint, overturned chair, dark corners, 35mm lens, chiaroscuro lighting
shots.motion: Slow lateral dolly to the right across the equipment banks. Dust motes swirl and drift through the shaft of light, the light beam creeps slowly across the consoles. Nothing else moves.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up macro of a vintage analogue signal meter set into a black bakelite panel, cracked glass face, cream dial with a thin red needle resting at zero, faded lettering, scratched brass bezel, shallow depth of field, single warm light source raking across the surface
shots.motion: The needle twitches once, then again, then begins to lift slowly off zero and tremble. The camera holds absolutely still. Faint flicker in the light.

shots.prompt: Wide seascape, an enormous black storm front advancing across a slate grey ocean toward the camera, curtains of rain hanging beneath the cloud base, a single shaft of pale light breaking through far on the horizon, whitecaps on the water, 50mm lens, high contrast, ominous scale
shots.motion: The storm front advances toward camera, clouds churning and rolling internally, rain curtains sweeping left to right, waves building and breaking. Slow handheld drift, the horizon rocking slightly.

shots.prompt: Low angle looking straight up a rusted steel lattice radio mast against a black roiling storm sky, guy wires cutting diagonally across the frame, red aircraft warning lamp near the top, rain streaking the lens, 20mm wide lens, dramatic perspective
shots.motion: The mast sways slightly in the wind, guy wires vibrating, the warning lamp pulsing on and off. Clouds race past behind it. Rain streaks across the lens. Camera slowly tilts further up.

shots.prompt: Interior of the dark radio control room, rows of small indicator lamps and illuminated valve tubes glowing awake across a black equipment rack, warm amber and green light pooling on dusty metal, everything else in deep shadow, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, bokeh
shots.motion: The indicator lamps flicker on in a slow cascade from left to right, valve filaments warming to orange, light building steadily in the room. Slow push in toward the rack. Faint electrical flicker.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of narrow paper tape spooling out of a mechanical teleprinter onto a dark desk, rows of punched holes and faint printed characters running along it, curled loops of tape pooling below, warm desk lamp light from the left, heavy shallow focus, 100mm macro
shots.motion: The tape feeds steadily out of the machine and coils into the pool below, the mechanism vibrating. The loops shift and settle under their own weight. Camera holds, very slight breathing drift.

shots.prompt: Exterior wide shot at night, the radio station silhouetted against a violent storm, a brilliant white beam firing upward from the mast into the black cloud base and scattering through the rain, the building windows glowing warm amber, waves exploding against the rocks below, 35mm lens, high contrast
shots.motion: The beam sweeps slowly through the cloud, scattering in the rain. Waves surge and explode against the rocks throwing spray high into frame. Clouds churn overhead. Slow crane up. Rain falling heavily.

shots.prompt: Extreme wide aerial view at dawn, the tiny radio station on its headland far below, a vast rugged coastline curving away into distant mist, the storm now dissipating out to sea, first warm sunlight catching the cliff tops, calm water, 16mm lens, immense sense of scale
shots.motion: Slow aerial pull back and rise, the station shrinking against the enormous coastline, mist drifting through the valleys below, light spreading slowly across the cliffs. Smooth continuous drone move.
